items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Todd. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Sightseeing. Yeah. And especially we had our own bus too...

ctx.x: Twelve pieces. Twelve pieces and an entertainer. And where would he work with Twelve Pieces? Oh, out of town mostly. That time I was playing music, I'd be hitting the roads, you know what I mean. And he was a man that would get Boyk. He was one of the ones, he was actually one of the ones. He would get Boyk all over. Go to a lot of town sometimes for his, Pensacola.
A lot of time. Uh huh. It must have been interesting to travel around throughout the country, Todd.

Yeah. Sightseeing. Yeah. And especially we had our own bus too, you know what I mean. I was just saying, I was understanding. Oh and one time I played with Desdun. Crash Desdun. Oh yeah, Crash Desdun huh? Yeah. I don't even know who it is.
